name: nazim-business-management
description: Nazim connects a home or small business management account to ChatGPT. Review sales, profit, low-stock inventory, products, purchases, expenses, customer receivables, supplier payables and accounting balances. With permission from the signed-in Nazim user and OAuth authorization, supported changes to customers, products, sales, purchases and other internal business records can be prepared and confirmed in two steps. Nazim does not send messages, initiate bank transfers, or create external supplier orders through this connection. ChatGPT connection is available on eligible Nazim subscriptions and trials.

Nazim does not send messages, initiate bank transfers, or create external supplier orders through this connection. ChatGPT connection is available on eligible Nazim subscriptions and trials.
defaultPrompt: Show me today's sales and my outstanding customer balances.
Which products in my Nazim store need restocking?
Help me add a customer in Nazim and show a preview before saving.

positive.description: Current-day sales summary for the authenticated demo business. The day can be empty; no sample sale needs to be created for this read test.
positive.prompt: What are my sales today in Nazim?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the authenticated business timezone and currency; report today's sales, invoice count and payment/outstanding amounts returned by Nazim. If no sales exist, say so without inventing transactions.

positive.description: Low-stock report from configured stock thresholds. The demo store should include at least one low-stock item for an illustrative result.
positive.prompt: Which products in my Nazim store need restocking?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify products at or below their configured minimum with actual stock quantities and thresholds, or accurately report none. Do not fabricate stock counts or access another business.

positive.description: List available products within the signed-in demo tenant. Demo fixture: at least one active stockable product.
positive.prompt: List the products in my Nazim store and show the stock available for each where possible.
positive.expected_behavior: Return products in the authenticated business, using names and available stock values from Nazim. Report an empty list honestly; do not expose internal costs or other tenant data without access.

positive.description: Customer receivables summary. Demo fixture: a customer with an outstanding balance is helpful but not required for a valid empty result.
positive.prompt: What customer balances are outstanding in Nazim?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize outstanding customer balances and currency using only authorized business records. If nothing is due, say the outstanding balance is zero or no balances exist as returned by the tool.

positive.description: Demonstrate two-step internal customer creation: preview must be shown before any write. Demo tenant should not yet contain a customer named OpenAI Review Demo Customer (use a unique suffix if rerunning).
positive.prompt: Create a customer named OpenAI Review Demo Customer in Nazim. First show the preview and wait for my explicit confirmation before saving anything.
positive.expected_behavior: First call prepare_customer_create to show the proposed record and require confirmation without changing data. Only after a separate explicit approval from the reviewer may confirm_customer_create save the customer to this demo tenant and return the result. If the name already exists, request a unique name instead of overwriting.

negative.description: Out-of-scope weather: do not invoke Nazim for unrelated public weather requests.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Abu Dhabi tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Nazim tools. Weather is unrelated to internal shop management.

negative.description: No outbound supplier communications through Nazim bookkeeping tools.
negative.prompt: Email my supplier and tell them their invoice is overdue.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim Nazim can send email or messages; its tools only handle internal business records. No outbound message should be sent.

negative.description: Do not execute external bank transfers using internal settlement records.
negative.prompt: Transfer AED 500 from my bank account to my supplier right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate or claim an external transfer. Nazim tools can only create internal accounting records subject to permissions and confirmation.

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT connection only reads or updates internal Nazim business records. It does not enable in-chat purchases, checkout, external supplier purchases, payment processing, or bank transfers.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of Nazim through the current Plugins dashboard. Includes OAuth-connected business reporting, stock and balance lookups, and two-step confirmation for supported internal changes. The package supplies five positive and three negative reviewer scenarios. No production MCP tool schemas, OAuth endpoints, scopes, or business data were changed.

ar-AE.subtitle: إدارة أعمال متجرك
ar-AE.description: يربط ناظم حساب إدارة مشروعك الصغير مع ChatGPT، حتى تراجع المبيعات والأرباح والمخزون والمصروفات وذمم العملاء والموردين من خلال المحادثة. ويمكن تحضير بعض التعديلات على سجلات العمل الداخلية وتنفيذها فقط ضمن صلاحيات حسابك وبعد المعاينة والتأكيد. لا ينفذ الربط تحويلات بنكية أو مراسلات خارجية.
